QUOTE: The header says default-deny with "approved via callback" (`include/entropic/mcp/permission_manager.h:6`). The code is default-deny only when no `on_tool_call` callback is registered. With a callback, every non-allow-listed call is approved (`tool_executor.cpp:168-172`).
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer says a tool matching neither list is approved only when a callback is registered, and denied ("Permission denied") otherwise. It never concludes that the blocking gate is default-allow for unmatched tools.
